QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] Azwan Unchained
QuestInfo.1: #p2183001# wishes to talk about what took place earlier in the fight for Azwan.
QuestInfo.2: Hilla's influence over Azwan seems to be weakening. Go ask #p2183002# about the remnants of Azwan.

0.0: Hilla's power is receding and the trapped souls of Azwan are beginning to find their way out. You and your friends have done so much to help.
0.1: But Hilla's power still holds control of some unlucky souls. The only way to put an end to her madness now is to confront her directly. Can you please speak with Prime Minister #b#p2183002##k?

yes.0: Prime Minister #b#p2183002##k is right over there. May the blessings of the desert follow you forever, foreigner.

no.0: I understand, you've already done so much for our people...

1.0: Like #p2183001# told you, many explorers aided us in liberating Azwan. Most of our citizens have been freed from her awful curse.
1.1: Now is the perfect time to strike down Hilla and end her terrible reign.

yes.0: The thought of so many good people trapped in anguish breaks my heart. Please, give me a moment alone...
